description: Edits and simulates deterministic finite automata.

methods.name: addEdge(source: string, target: string, type = TP_DFA_TRANSITION, sourcePort?: TpGraphPort, targetPort?: TpGraphPort, direction: TpGraphEdgeDirection = "forward"): TpGraphEdge
methods.description: Adds a forward transition between existing state IDs, using optional connection ports; returns the edge record. Unsupported types, directions or endpoints throw.

methods.name: addNode(type: string, point: TpGraphPoint, label?: string): TpGraphNode
methods.description: Adds a DFA state or comment at graph coordinates point with the optional label; returns a detached node record. Unsupported types throw TypeError.

methods.name: readNext(duration = 300): Promise<boolean>
methods.description: Consumes and animates one input symbol using duration milliseconds. Resolves to true if a symbol was processed, not whether the word is accepted; false means no further step is possible.

methods.name: reset(word = this.inputWord): void
methods.description: Restarts reading word at the initial state and clears rejection and transition highlights; omitted word reuses the current input. Emits tp-dfa-reset.

methods.name: run(duration = 600): Promise<boolean>
methods.description: Processes remaining symbols with duration milliseconds per step, stopping at the end or rejection. Resolves to whether the complete word is accepted; does not reset the input first.

methods.name: setGraph(graph: TpGraphDocument): void
methods.description: Validates the specialized graph before replacing the editor graph; retains the base editor cloning and undo-history behavior. Invalid data throws without replacing the graph.

events.name: tp-dfa-reset
events.description: Emitted after the input word, consumed-symbol count and active state are reset. stateId is null when no initial state is available; graph is the resulting snapshot.
events.detail: { word: string; stateId: string | null; graph: TpGraphDocument }

events.name: tp-dfa-step
events.description: Emitted after consuming one symbol and completing its transition animation. position is the number of consumed symbols; accepted and rejected describe the resulting state.
events.detail: { symbol: string; position: number; stateId: string | null; accepted: boolean; rejected: boolean; graph: TpGraphDocument }

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-graph-dfa>` element implements the <tp-icon name="graph-dfa" library="components" size="1.25em"></tp-icon> Deterministic finite automaton functionality: edits and simulates deterministic finite automata.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Component itself | No dedicated pointer control; use any displayed child controls normally. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Play | <kbd>Enter</kbd> a word in the toolbar below the canvas. **Play** consumes the next symbol and highlights the active transition and state. **Run word** reads the complete word automatically with a visible 600 ms interval between transitions. **Reset** returns to the initial state. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
